tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H ≤ 0.48, whereas the target horizon is 21.6. A long-horizon probe is needed to identify the slow adaptation and distinguish reversal mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon rows cannot reliably identify both timescales or the long-horizon adaptation term.
The long-horizon discriminating probe directly addresses the extrapolation ambiguity.
It does not address the temporal identifiability problem.
